title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling samples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: Add curated RAG agent templates and step-by-step quickstarts for tool-calling workflows to the docs site and examples repo. Motivation: provide engineers with reproducible starter templates for retrieval-augmented generation + tool-calling, reduce onboarding time, and surface best-practice defaults for caching, prompt structure, and error handling. Changes: added RAG agent templates (python + ts), tool-calling example quickstarts, updated docs site pages, added images/diagrams, and a lightweight README for the examples folder. Checklist: - [x] Add Python quickstart and template - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and template - [x] Update docs site quickstart page and navigation - [x] Add diagrams and copy edits - [x] Run doc lint and CI fixes - [x] Add smoke tests for examples How to review: focus on the quickstart instructions (env var coverage, toggles for hosted vs dedicated), ensure examples use the SDK idioms recommended by the platform, and validate the docs page renders correctly in the preview build. Testing notes: examples validated locally against a short-lived API key; docs preview built in CI; fixed initial doc-lint errors and re-ran preview. Related: ENG-4821 (RAG onboarding), PM-214 (quickstarts roadmap).
